refnamediv.refpurpose: Fetch the SNMP objects below an object id from an agent

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
arrayfalsesnmp3_walk stringhostname stringsecurity_name stringsecurity_level stringauth_protocol stringauth_passphrase stringprivacy_protocol stringprivacy_passphrase arraystringobject_id inttimeout-1 intretries-1
snmp3_walk function is used to read all the values below object_id from an SNMP agent specified by the hostname.
The authentication and privacy arguments must always be passed, but their values are ignored when security_level does not use them.

&reftitle.examples;
snmp3_walk Example
<?php $ret = snmp3_walk('localhost', 'james', 'authPriv', 'SHA', 'secret007', 'AES', 'secret007', 'IF-MIB::ifName'); var_export($ret); ?>
Above function call would return the ifName objects of the SNMP agent running on localhost:
array ( 0 => 'STRING: "lo"', 1 => 'STRING: "eth0"', 2 => 'STRING: "eth2"', 3 => 'STRING: "sit0"', 4 => 'STRING: "sixxs"', )
